title: Bind SCHC ACK bytes inseparably to verifier-produced authentication metadata
description: Security codereview found FragmentSender.handle_ack_bytes accepts arbitrary ACK bytes separately from a publicly constructible AuthenticatedSessionContext, so metadata from one authenticated frame can be paired with substituted C=1 bytes. Replace the detached API with a verifier-produced immutable envelope/result that binds exact payload, canonical identities, and replay acceptance (or an unforgeable payload-bound token). Add substitution tests proving authenticated NACK metadata cannot authorize different ACK bytes.
notes: Post-fix correctness review: publicly constructible RxFrame is not an authenticity capability. Make construction verifier-only or route ACK processing directly from LinkLayer, include actual receiving-local identity, and verify with signed-wire integration tests.
